title: Common providers: Malaysia
coverage: Complete for the fixed-line incumbent, the mobile network operators, the main fibre providers and the wholesale 5G network; business ISPs and the operators of Sabah and Sarawak are partial.
missing: Regional operators of Sabah and Sarawak other than Sacofa
A website for TIME (it refused an automated check on the read date)
Status pages (none was found that answered a check)

sources.name: MCMC (Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission): registers of licences
sources.terms: The site shows a copyright notice; its terms-of-use page did not answer on the read date, so nothing is copied.
sources.result: The page answered on the read date. It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in Malaysia and Telecommunications in Malaysia
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names and ownership (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 9 of 11 names were found on the pages.

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 10 of 11 websites and 2 business, support or status pages answered an automated check; an address that did not answer is left empty.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat service terms were read on the read date; RIPEstat data is not redistributed: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, the registered holder and that the number is announced.
sources.result: 15 AS numbers confirmed; a number whose registered holder was another company, or that was not announced on the read date, was left out.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.terms: CC0 1.0: no conditions. The item id of a provider is recorded as a stable cross-reference.
sources.result: 1 entries carry the id of their own Wikidata item; each item states one of the entry's AS numbers (property P3797). A parent group's item is not used.

sources.name: PeeringDB
sources.terms: The acceptable use policy forbids reproducing PeeringDB data outside approved operational purposes: nothing is copied; cited as a place to look up an AS number.

providers.name: TM
providers.notes: unifi is its retail name; the support address is the unifi site.

providers.name: Maxis
providers.notes: Mobile and fibre. The support address is the business site.

providers.name: CelcomDigi
providers.notes: The merged Celcom (AS10030) and Digi (AS4818, AS10081); the numbers are still registered under the two former names.

providers.name: TIME
providers.notes: Its website refused an automated check on the read date.
